cost.logical_cost_note: Physical calls shared by identical packets are counted once. Per-arm logical costs must not be summed as physical execution cost.

scope: Controlled source-evidence diagnostic on known questions, not new-source generalization and not an independent advantage claim over strong_chain. Bridge and side groups are separate; no factorial interaction/synergy claim.
primary: Per group, sham minus critical in preservation of the original supported response (bridge: reference-answer EM; side: CONFLICT response). Report paired difference, wins/losses/ties, exact discordant sign test and fixed-seed descriptive bootstrap95. No baseline-correctness filter.
secondary: Intact vs sham perturbation control; critical context-appropriate response (UNKNOWN for lost bridge; remaining supported answer for lost side); F1, invalid responses, source lengths and full cost ledger. Never score a correctly changed answer as failure against the original CONFLICT label.
cost_policy: Report actual new and reused calls separately; reuse retains historical inference cost. This reader-only intervention run does not establish end-to-end selector speedup.
interpretation: Original-response preservation is a mechanism readout, NOT accuracy after evidence changes. A supported change to UNKNOWN/remaining answer is scored separately as context-appropriate.
